svg.title: Signals: metrics, logs, traces and alerts
svg.desc: Metrics: Prometheus scrapes node-exporter, kube-state-metrics, Traefik, the blackbox exporter and every ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor and Probe in the cluster, and keeps 15 days. Logs: Alloy tails pod logs and cluster events and writes them to Loki, which keeps 30 days. Traces: Traefik sends OTLP traces to Alloy, which exports them to Tempo, which keeps 72 hours. Grafana reads all three stores and shows 14 dashboards kept in Git. Alerts: alert rules in Prometheus and critical Falco events reach Alertmanager, which sends them through the alertmanager-ntfy adapter to ntfy. Alertmanager also pings healthchecks.io with the Watchdog alert about every 2 minutes, and healthchecks.io emails when the pings stop. Argo CD notifications post sync failures and degraded health straight to ntfy.
svg.text: and every ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor and Probe in the cluster
Traefik request traces, sent as OTLP
All of it deploys in the services wave: kube-prometheus-stack, loki, tempo, alloy, prometheus-blackbox-exporter, alertmanager-ntfy, ntfy, falco.
